# Miss International Queen Vietnam 2023

Miss International Queen Vietnam 2023, the 3rd Miss International Queen Vietnam pageant, was held on 8 April 2023, in Hồ Chí Minh City. Vietnam. Phùng Trương Trân Đài of California crowned her successor Nguyễn Hà Dịu Thảo of Hải Dương at the end of the event.

Judges
The Miss International Queen Vietnam 2023 final judges were:
*Nguyễn Hương Giang — Miss International Queen 2018.
*Hoàng Thị Thùy — Winner of Vietnam's Next Top Model (season 2), 1st Runner-Up of Miss Universe Vietnam 2017 and Top 20 at Miss Universe 2019.
*Rinrada Thurapan — Miss Tiffany's Universe 2018 and 2nd Runner-Up at Miss International Queen 2018.
*Fuchsia Anne Ravena — Miss International Queen 2022.
*Lukkade Metinee — Supermodel Thailand and Miss Thailand 1992.
*Nguyễn Huỳnh Như — Star Idol of Vietnam.
Mentor
*Huỳnh Phạm Thủy Tiên — 2nd Runner-Up Miss Universe Vietnam 2022.
*Chế Nguyễn Quỳnh Châu — 1st Runner-Up Miss Grand Vietnam 2022.
*Ngô Thị Quỳnh Mai — 4th Runner-Up Miss Grand Vietnam 2022.
*Bùi Quỳnh Hoa — Miss Universe Vietnam 2023.
